# Dot files

This is a collection of dotfiles for various tools and applications, including configuration files for the shell, text editors, and other utilities that I use on a daily basis.

</div>

## :pushpin:About The Project

The idea of the project is to have a central repository for all my dotfiles, which can be easily cloned and used on any machine. The root of the repository will be the **home directory** of the user.

### Tools

- Tmux (`.tmux.conf`)
- Ghostty (`.config/ghostty/config.ghostty`)
